title: Developing a Theologically Rooted Christian Vision
description:
This course is about developing a theologically rooted Christian for your school. You will learn about:

  • Developing a vision.

  • Developing a vision that is theologically rooted.

  • Developing a Christian vision that is theologically rooted.

As well as other stuff. This course will help you in all sorts of ways.
